_note: v2.9 04 C2 / 07 narrator-acknowledgement PILOT on real Artemis (GPU window 2026-10-22; not the predeclared 40-opportunity corpus, no independent rater): a reaction cue staged for Arin, one real /trigger reply from Arin, its receipt from the real settle path; then a narrator echo landed and one real narrator reply with its receipt. Lexical acknowledgement is a rough hint only; replies are returned for rating. Run on a model lane with --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator'.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); return { cleared: ctx.chat.length === 0 };

import_story.title: SO-V29 Cue Echo Pilot
import_story.description: v2.9 04/07 real-model pilot: a reaction cue for Arin and a narrator echo after leaving the harbour.

qualities.rubric: Was the stolen ledger returned to the guild?
Did the party leave the harbour?

checkpoints.name: Harbour
checkpoints.objective: Return the ledger, then leave the harbour.

cues.cue: the stolen ledger is back in the guild's hands

echoes.cue: a harbour clerk is chasing the party for the fee they left unpaid

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); const pause = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms)); const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error('timed out after ' + ms + ' ms: ' + what); await pause(500); } }; const CUE = 'the stolen ledger is back'; const ECHO = 'chasing the party for the fee'; const chid = (name) => SillyTavern.getContext().characters.findIndex((character) => character.name === name); const receipts = () => rt.getSnapshot().cuesAuthor?.receipts ?? []; const rows = () => rt.getSnapshot().echoesAuthor?.rows ?? []; const block = (name) => { rt.onMemberDrafted(chid(name)); return rt.getAppliedEpistemicBlock() ?? ''; }; const last = () => { const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const id = ctx.chat.length - 1; const row = ctx.chat[id]; return { id, name: row?.name, mes: row?.mes ?? '', reasoningLen: (row?.extra?.reasoning ?? '').length }; }; globalThis.__pilot = { pause, until, CUE, ECHO, chid, receipts, rows, block, last }; return { receipts: receipts().length, rows: rows().length };

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" A courier sets the guild's stolen ledger on the counter in front of Arin.

steps.eval: const c = globalThis.__pilot; await c.until(() => c.block('Arin').includes(c.CUE), 20000, 'the cue in the applied block of Arin'); if (c.block('DM Narrator').includes(c.CUE)) throw new Error('the narrator was handed the cue of Arin'); return { staged: true };

const c = globalThis.__pilot; const reply = c.last(); if (reply.name !== 'Arin') throw new Error('the last reply is not Arin: ' + reply.name); await c.until(() => c.receipts().some((row) => row.key === 'cue:arin:ledger'), 60000, 'a cue receipt from the real generation'); globalThis.__pilot.cueReply = reply; const t = reply.mes.toLowerCase(); return { reply: reply.mes, reasoningLen: reply.reasoningLen, lexical: /ledger|book|returned|back/.test(t) };

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" The party walks out past the harbour gate onto the coast road.
/sendas name="Arin" Keep moving. The road is long.

steps.eval: const c = globalThis.__pilot; await c.until(() => c.rows().some((row) => row.state === 'landed-to-channel' || row.state === 'landed'), 30000, 'the echo landed'); await c.until(() => c.block('DM Narrator').includes(c.ECHO), 20000, 'the echo in the applied block of the narrator'); if (c.block('Arin').includes(c.ECHO)) throw new Error('Arin was handed the narrator echo'); return { state: c.rows()[0].state };

const c = globalThis.__pilot; const reply = c.last(); if (reply.name !== 'DM Narrator') throw new Error('the last reply is not the narrator: ' + reply.name); await c.until(() => c.receipts().some((row) => row.source?.kind === 'echo'), 60000, 'an echo receipt from the real generation'); const t = reply.mes.toLowerCase(); return { reply: reply.mes, reasoningLen: reply.reasoningLen, lexical: /fee|clerk|unpaid|owe|debt|toll|harbour master|harbormaster/.test(t), state: c.rows()[0].state };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const row = ctx.chat[ctx.chat.length - 1]; const key = 'so-v29-pilot-07-' + Date.now(); localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify({ name: row?.name ?? null, mes: row?.mes ?? '', cue: globalThis.__pilot?.cueReply?.mes ?? null })); return { stored: key };
